summary.headline: Jupiter in Scorpio and Sagittarius
summary.text: Astrological prognostications for Jupiter’s entry into Scorpio and Sagittarius, including winds, rains, disease, famine, war, captivity, agriculture, earthquakes, and political conditions. Authorities cited include Buzurjmihr ibn Bakhtakan, Democritus, Hermes, and Ahmad ʿAbd al-Jalil, with references to Sham, Maghreb, Fars, Tabriz, and Constantinople.
